faq.a1: Yes. All vocabulary, mini-games, grammar, and topics are free forever. Only advanced AI features (Goethe/TELC exam prep, writing/speaking grading) need Premium — with a 3/week limit for Free users.
faq.q2: Do I need to pay to practise Goethe/TELC?
faq.a2: Free users get 3 uses/week for all AI features including exam prep. Premium unlocks unlimited A1/A2/B1 exams, AI grading, and AI error explanations in Vietnamese.
faq.a3: Deutschmeister uses Google's Gemini AI — trained on massive language data. It grades against Goethe/TELC criteria: grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, content. Every error has a detailed Vietnamese explanation.
faq.q4: How do I pay for Premium?
faq.a4: Bank transfer or scan VietQR. After transferring with the correct memo, the admin confirms within a few hours (max 24h) and Premium activates automatically. See the Pricing page for details.
faq.q5: Which levels does the app support?
faq.a5: A1 (beginner), A2 (elementary), B1 (intermediate) — all 4 skills Listen/Speak/Read/Write in Goethe-Zertifikat and TELC Deutsch format. Suitable from beginners to exam candidates.
faq.q6: Do I need to install anything? Is there a mobile app?
faq.a6: No installation — runs entirely in the browser. A mobile app (Android/iOS) is in development and coming soon. Accounts are shared across web and mobile.
faq.a7: Pay once, use forever — no monthly/yearly renewal. This is an Early Bird deal limited to the first 500 spots. You'll get an Early Backer badge and priority on new features. Once 500 spots are gone, it won't reopen.

story.item1Para1: I started German from zero — knowing nothing but "Hallo" and "Danke". I opened the book and was hit by der, die, das — three genders that don't exist in Vietnamese. I remembered the table is "der Tisch" but the chair is also "der Stuhl", while the door is "die Tür". No rule at all.
story.item1Para2: I used Duolingo, Anki, Google Translate — a bit of each but none was enough. Duolingo doesn't explain grammar for Vietnamese speakers. Anki is too dry. Vietnamese resources were scarce, scattered, and unsystematic.
story.item2Para1: When preparing for Goethe A1, I realised: no tool generates Goethe-format exams in Vietnamese. Want to practise Lesen Teil 1? You must hunt for old papers online, photocopy them, grade yourself. Want to practise Schreiben? After writing, no one corrects it — you don't know what's wrong.
story.item2Para2: Speaking was even harder — no study partner, afraid to make mistakes, opening your mouth only to remember "Ich heiße..." then freezing. I learned alone, sometimes so discouraged I wanted to quit.
story.item3Para1: I asked myself: "What if there were an app that teaches words, plays review games, generates Goethe-format exams, and even has AI grading for writing and speaking — all in Vietnamese?"
story.item3Para2: I'm a developer, and I decided to build what I needed. Not to run a business, but because no suitable tool existed. Every feature in Deutschmeister was born from real pain: can't remember noun genders → Gender Quiz. No one to correct your writing → AI grading. Forget words right after learning → SRS reminders.
story.finalPara1: Deutschmeister isn't a big company's product. It's the product of a German learner, built for German learners. Every line of code, every feature, started from one question: "Does this help me learn better?"
story.finalPara2: I know the path to learning German is long and sometimes lonely. But I hope with Deutschmeister you'll have a companion — imperfect, but always there, 24/7, ready to generate papers to practise, correct your work, and remind you to review words every day.
story.quote: "German is hard, but not unlearnable. You just need the right tools and enough patience."
